description: This bar chart illustrates Recall@10 values for different model configurations. The horizontal axis displays the categories “Ours”, “- critiquing”, “- scoring”, and “- ranking”, presented in that order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Recall@10”, represents values on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.4, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Four individual bars are displayed, each with a distinct label corresponding to the horizontal axis categories. The “Ours” bar is colored orange and extends to approximately 0.34. The “- critiquing” bar is blue and reaches a height of approximately 0.29. The “- scoring” bar is also blue and extends to approximately 0.17, while the “- ranking” bar is blue and reaches approximately 0.23.  No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
